sources.title: PyTorch Autograd mechanics
sources.authority_reason: PyTorch maintainers’ own documentation at the exact installed source revision.
sources.inspection_note: Personally read original saved bytes: How autograd encodes history and Setting requires_grad / Default Mode / No-grad Mode / Evaluation Mode. Input requiring grad records fixed-weight operations; only requiring-grad leaves accumulate grad. Does not promise nonzero gradients for every possible input or configuration.

sources.title: PyTorch Tensor.backward and Tensor.norm
sources.authority_reason: PyTorch maintainers’ original implementation at the installed source revision.
sources.inspection_note: Personally read lines 566–620 and 888–904: backward is chain-rule differentiation and gradient accumulation, while norm delegates to torch.norm. Execution distinguishes this from an optimizer update.

sources.title: PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss class-index reduction and ignore_index
sources.authority_reason: PyTorch maintainers’ original implementation and API documentation at installed revision.
sources.inspection_note: Personally read CrossEntropyLoss lines 1200–1299: class-index cross-entropy formula, ignore_index zero contribution and sum/mean denominator. Repo masked_loss explicitly computes sum / nonignored count.

Identical entry features cannot convey an image distinction
sources.details: For deterministic fixed prompt q and identical entrance representation z(I1)=z(I2), any fixed projector P gives P(z(I1))=P(z(I2)); downstream conditional output distribution is identical. A prior may guess a missing property, but the entrance supplies no basis to distinguish these images.

issues.original: 練習將接頭也凍結，在 backward 前印可訓練總數，會是 0，接著 backward 報代價未連到可求梯度參數。這是關閉所有學習路徑的反例，應在啟動訓練前攔下。
issues.evidence: cpu.stdout.json freeze_before_forward vs freeze_after_forward; actual subprocess receipts saved.
issues.impact: 讀者在loss已建立後才凍結會得到可訓練0而backward不報錯；核心學習問題正是凍結參數與梯度圖的不同，故須明示時機。
issues.suggested_revision: 練習把 model.image_projector.requires_grad_(True) 改成 False，從建立模型開始重新執行；在 loss.backward() 前印可訓練總數與 loss.requires_grad，預期為 0 和 False，接著 backward 會報錯。若在 forward 後才凍結，已建立的計算圖仍存在，這次 backward 不一定報錯。
issues.resolution: Coordinator只改最後練習段，明示既有True改False、從模型建立重新跑與forward前凍結；增加loss.requires_grad False以及保留late-freeze已有圖的反例。本人完整重讀現版11.3，重讀原PyTorch timing/chain-rule規約，在三個cold CPU process真跑原fence、新exercise與late-freeze，結果與文句吻合。初版問題/原句/原結果全部保留。
issues.actual_rechecked_paragraph: 練習把 `model.image_projector.requires_grad_(True)` 改成 `False`，從建立模型開始重新執行整段程式。在 `loss.backward()` 前印可訓練總數與 `loss.requires_grad`，預期為 `0` 和 `False`；接著 backward 會因代價沒有梯度路徑而報錯。這是在前向計算前關閉全部梯度來源的反例，應在啟動訓練前攔下。若在 `out = model(...)` 之後才凍結，已建立的計算圖仍在，這次 backward 可以執行。
